offering_description.value: Provides economic, financial and management consulting to law firms, corporations and government agencies. Its consultants analyze markets, company records and financial data to support litigation, regulatory proceedings and business strategy.

primary_services.value: litigation analysis and expert testimony; antitrust and regulatory consulting; financial valuation and damages analysis; forensic investigations; strategy and management consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: law firms, corporations and financial institutions; B2G: government agencies and competition regulators

end_markets.value: legal services; government and regulatory agencies; financial services; life sciences; energy and utilities

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly billing for consulting, analysis and expert testimony; project or contract: fixed-fee consulting engagements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: analyzes client records and market data for law firms, corporations and government agencies

geography_served.value: global: international clients served from offices in North America and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: litigation and regulatory economics, financial and forensic advisory, and management consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: consulting teams engaged directly by law firms, corporations and government agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business and data privacy rules, plus court rules for expert testimony
